function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | What It Looks Like | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|--------------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑legged briefs that cover the hips and thighs. | Everyday wear, gym, travel. | • Full coverage, good support.
• Usually made from cotton, modal, or blends.
• Tighter waistband for stability. | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑legged, snug fit with a defined waistband. | Casual, office, light activity. | • Minimal coverage, great for low‑profile shirts.
• Often have a “V” or “U” cut for comfort.
• Good for those who dislike the bulk of boxers. | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑legged, no waist support. | Sleep, lounging, casual. | • Breathable, airy feel.
• Great for hot climates.
• Can be less supportive for active use. | | **Trunks** | Short‑legged, similar to briefs but with a slightly longer leg. | Sports, everyday wear. | • Combines the support of briefs with a bit more coverage.
• Often have a tapered leg for a modern look. | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive waistband with a pouch and a thin elastic band across the hips. | Sports, high‑impact activities. | • Excellent support for the groin.
• Minimal fabric for breathability.
• Ideal for athletes or those who need extra support. | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, full‑coverage briefs with a compression layer. | Recovery, high‑intensity training. | • Helps reduce muscle vibration.
• Often made from spandex blends.
• Good for post‑workout recovery. | | **Performance/Tech Underwear** | Made from moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor fabrics. | Outdoor, travel, long days. | • Keeps you dry and odor‑free.
• Usually has flat seams to reduce chafing.
• Often includes UV protection. | | **Luxury/Designer** | Premium fabrics (silk, cashmere, high‑grade cotton). | Special occasions, gifting. | • Softest feel, often with subtle branding.
• May feature unique cuts or embellishments. | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Daily Activities** - **Active Lifestyle**: Go for compression briefs or performance underwear. - **Office/Business Casual**: Classic briefs or trunks offer a clean look. - **Relaxation & Sleep**: Boxers or loose briefs are best. 2. **Fabric Matters** - **Cotton**: Breathable, natural, but can wrinkle. - **Modal / Microfiber**: Soft, moisture‑wicking, less prone to pilling. - **Spandex / Lycra**: Adds stretch and shape retention. - **Silk / Cashmere**: Luxurious feel, great for gifting. 3. **Fit & Comfort** - **Waistband**: Should sit at the natural waist without digging. - **Leg Cut**: Avoid tightness around the thighs; look for a “no‑chafing” seam. - **Pouch**: For briefs, a well‑designed pouch can improve support. 4. **Durability & Care** - Look for reinforced stitching at stress points. - Check washing instructions—some performance fabrics need cold wash only. 5. **Style & Color** - Neutral colors (black, navy, gray) are versatile. - If you like a pop of color, choose a subtle stripe or pattern. --- ## Top Brands (as of 2026) | Brand | Specialty | Notable Products | |-------|-----------|------------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic briefs & trunks | “CK 360” briefs, “CK Trunks” | | **Uniqlo** | Affordable, high‑quality basics | AIRism line, Ultra Light Crew | | **Saxx** | Innovative pouch design | “Underwear of the Future” | | **Under Armour** | Performance tech | “UA Tech” briefs, compression line | | **Tommy John** | Comfort‑centric | “Second Skin” briefs, “Cool Dri” | | **Lululemon** | Athletic, breathable | “Align” briefs, “Fast & Free” | | **Hanes** | Budget friendly | Classic briefs, boxer briefs | | **Bamboo** | Eco‑friendly, bamboo fabric | “Bamboo” line, “Eco‑Comfort” | | **Polo Ralph Lauren** | Luxury & heritage | “Polo” briefs, “Polo” trunks | | **Laverne** | Sustainable, fair‑trade | “Laverne” briefs, “Laverne” trunks | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **What’s the difference between boxers and boxer briefs?** | Boxers are loose and long‑legged; boxer briefs are tighter and offer more support. | | **Do I need a pouch?** | Pouches provide extra support and reduce friction. If you’re active or have a larger build, a pouch is recommended. | | **Can I wear underwear with a tight‑fitting shirt?** | Yes—briefs or trunks are best for low‑profile shirts to avoid visible lines. | | **How often should I replace my underwear?** | Every 6–12 months, or sooner if you notice wear, loss of elasticity, or odor issues. | | **Is cotton the best fabric?** | Cotton is breathable but can retain moisture. For sweaty days, consider moisture‑wicking blends. | --- ### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort**: Boxer briefs or trunks. - **For sports or high‑impact activities**: Compression briefs or jockstraps. - **For lounging or sleep**: Boxers or loose briefs. - **For luxury or gifting**: Silk or cashmere options. Pick the style that matches your lifestyle, prioritize a good fit, and choose fabrics that keep you comfortable all day long. Happy shopping!
